svg.title: Synchronous request and its telemetry spans
svg.desc: A synchronous job crosses the timing middleware, the handler (validation and routing), the worker (queue, parse, route, compile) and the engine; each hop is a named span and the spans add up exactly to the total round trip.

text.tspan: total_roundtrip = orchestration_overhead + worker_service; dispatch_rtt = network_transit + worker_service
